sloka: स नेमिघोषेण महान्सहसाभिनिनादयन् ।राजमार्गम् श्रिया जुष्टम् प्रतिपेदे महारथः ॥६-११-१०॥।।
transliteration: sa nemighoṣeṇa mahānsahasābhininādayan ।rājamārgam śriyā juṣṭam pratipede mahārathaḥ ॥6-11-10॥।।

translations.english: As the rattling sounds of the great chariot echoed in all directions, he entered the bright pleasing royal path all at once.
